title: 社交媒体压力
text: 上个星期，我发现自己每天花太多时间看手机。现在很多人觉得网络生活很累。我们总是想知道朋友在做什么。即使没有重要事情，我们也经常检查手机。这种行为让人无法集中注意力。很多人担心自己错过新鲜消息。即使关掉手机，他们也会感到不安。这种感觉影响了我们的休息。人们在网上看到别人的好生活，容易觉得不开心。其实，照片里的一切不一定是真实的。我们应该多关注现实世界。多和家人聊天，或者去公园走走。减少用手机的时间，能让心情变好。简单的生活才更有意义。我们必须学会控制网络使用。这样才能找回真正的快乐。

questions.prompt: According to the text, how do people often feel after seeing others' seemingly good lives online?
What does the text say about the content shown in photos posted online?
Even after turning off their phone, how do many people still feel, according to the text?
What does the text suggest doing instead of spending time on the phone?
options: Chatting with family or going to the park

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does constantly checking the phone prevent people from doing?

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
